title: GTA 6 PC pe kab aayega?
hooks: GTA 6 PC kab aayega? Rockstar ne chhupa rakha hai secret
GTA 6 PC requirements sab fake hain
Console pe khel rahe ho ya PC ka wait kar rahe ho?
hook_why: Opens with the exact question every PC gamer is asking, adds urgency with 'secret', no greeting.
metaphor: A timeline showing Rockstar's console-first pattern: announce -> launch -> optimize -> PC port.

caption: GTA 6 PC kab aayega? Rockstar ne abhi tak date nahi di. Fake specs se bachna. Console 2025, PC 2026-27 expected. Tu console pe khel raha hai ya PC ka wait? Comment mein batao! #GTA6 #KaiseTech #PCGaming

claims.claim: GTA 6 trailer released December 2023; console launch window confirmed for 2025 by Take-Two.
claims.basis: Official Rockstar Games trailer and Take-Two earnings calls.

claims.claim: No official PC version announcement exists as of 2024.
claims.basis: Rockstar Games official platform announcements and Newswire.

claims.claim: Historical pattern: GTA V console 2013 -> PC 2015 (1.5 years); RDR2 console 2018 -> PC 2019 (1 year).
claims.basis: Public release date records for both titles.

items.head: Fake specs red flags
items.text: Ignore any 'minimum/recommended specs' video — Rockstar has released ZERO PC specs

items.head: Historical gap reference
items.text: GTA V: 2 yr gap | RDR2: 1 yr gap → expect 1–2 yrs after Nov 19, 2026 console launch

items.head: Realistic PC target
items.text: Plan for late 2026 / early 2027; do not pre-order or buy hardware on rumours
